sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of W-D-W-W-W, though they'll face a struggling Alsager side who sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with Stafford sitting just two points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the standings, host Eccleshall in what promises to be a tight contest between two strong sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Bilston Town (6th, in good form with W-W-D-W-W) entertain Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United; both are mid-table sides seeking to maintain momentum. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a lower-table clash, and Crewe travel to face Allscott Heath. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest sides, while Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the league's lowest-ranked team with just 2 points and winless across their recent form.
